name: The Wakey Show ～ ザ･ウェイキー･ショウ
original_name: The Wakey Show ～ ザ･ウェイキー･ショウ
overview: This edutainment show features the main character Wakey and his friends delivering interesting information to elementary school students before they head to school, making their day more enjoyable. It provides a "doorway to knowledge" that invites them into NHK Educational TV's diverse educational content, including science, nature, art, and history. It's packed with fun segments to wake up children's minds and bodies, including games, dance, live music, cooking, comedy sketches, city exploration, manga, and more!
